Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Sections start with `.p2align 2`, which is llvm-mc's default alignment for
SPARC code and data and not rsasm's; see mips.txt.

=== hi and lo of a label in another section
        .text
        .p2align 2
        sethi   %hi(msg), %o0
        or      %o0, %lo(msg), %o0
        ld      [%o0 + %lo(msg)], %o1
        retl
        nop
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .space  0x1400
msg:    .word   1

=== hi and lo with an addend
        .text
        .p2align 2
        sethi   %hi(msg + 0x3ff), %o0
        add     %o0, %lo(msg + 0x3ff), %o0
        sethi   %hi(msg - 1), %o1
        retl
        nop
        .data
        .p2align 2
msg:    .word   1

=== call and branches into another section
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        call    helper
        nop
        ba      helper
        nop
        .section .text.helper, "ax"
        .p2align 2
helper:
        bne     entry
        nop

=== data across sections
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        retl
        nop
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .word   entry
        .word   entry - .

=== set of a label
        .text
        .p2align 2
        set     msg, %g1
        set     msg + 0x400, %g2
        retl
        nop
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .space  0x2000
msg:    .word   1
